A dedicated independent adversarial review ran the exploit-class probes (integrator-neuron genuineness -- confirmed the p/q integrator fires 512/512 dimensions, fallback never reached; symbol/answer leakage -- none, symbols drawn before facts on a separate RNG; recognition load-bearing -- confirmed, misrecognition propagates; abstention genuine; protected-set byte-empty diff vs e8a99a2; no autograd) and returned CLEAR. Shortcut 2 already attempted (activity-level integration, 2026-05-22, see the next pillar): the naive form -- derive the symbol from raw single-observation substrate activity -- is NEGATIVE (substrate activity coefficient of variation ~1.63, far above the regime where derivation survives). G.20 sparse does not have these components; the (c) design required either porting G.20 sparse into build_biological_brain_regions (OPTION 1, substantial integration work) or re-validating parallel-matching on this substrate (OPTION 3).
